title: Aureline M5 stack-member landing posture
description: Canonical per-domain descriptor for one patch-stack member card's landing posture: the member's position in a patch stack / queue and its separated local stack state, provider-linked review state, and queue/landing posture, so which member blocks another, which checks are stale, and which members are ready, blocked, or not yet landing candidates are visible metadata rather than a branch-naming convention. Names the object class, its change-orchestration association, the stack ID and member ID it belongs to, the parent member it depends on, its landing order and rebase epoch, the source of its stack membership, and the freshness of its validation — so a member's local stack state is never shown as a provider-accepted landing candidate, stack members are never silently reordered, and stack membership is never inferred from branch names alone. Downstream the patch-stack / queue, stack-edit / review sheet, provider-landing, and support / export packets point at this schema instead of restating member-landing behavior by hand. Raw paths, raw provider payloads, secret values, and private endpoints never cross this boundary.
